overall_reason: A stock Tailwind/Inter SaaS skeleton (pill badge, two-line h1, mock-card hero, stat trio, equal card grids with caps labels, sticky CTA pills) that an agent prompted with 'landing page for an AI tool recommender' would produce nearly verbatim; the only specific content is the tool list itself.

findings.evidence: Failed T-DEFAULT-AGENT: pale blue-grey page (oklch 0.973 0.006 264), Inter body with Space Grotesk display, one royal-blue accent, pill badge 'Personalized AI tool bundles' with status dot, white rounded-2xl cards with hairline border and soft shadow, black pill 'View details' buttons. This is the saas-card-kit look family end to end; the 'Edit with Lovable' badge in tile 1440-00 confirms the builder default was shipped unchanged.
findings.before: Default Tailwind/shadcn kit: Inter + Space Grotesk, blue accent, rounded-2xl white cards, pill badge above h1
findings.after: Pick one visual decision that belongs to a 'stack builder' (e.g. stacked-layer motif, or a real recommendation output as the hero) and let the kit recede; [DATA NEEDED: brand direction]
findings.why: Nothing in the visual system was chosen for this product; it is the builder's default.

findings.where: 'What are you trying to accomplish?' grid and 'AI Tools Directory' grid (tiles 1440-00 to 1440-02)
findings.evidence: Ten identical goal cards (caps blue label, h3, one-line description) in a 3-column grid leaving one orphan card ('Design faster') alone on the last row, then six identical tool cards each ending in a full-width black 'View details' pill. Failed T-STOCK-ORDER: badge hero with mock UI, stat trio, equal feature cards, equal product cards, table, minimal footer = 5 stock sections in stock order.
findings.before: 10 equal goal cards, 3-up, with an orphan; 6 equal tool cards with 6 identical CTAs
findings.after: Make the goal picker an actual control (a single select row or chip set that leads into the questionnaire) and drop the duplicate per-card 'View details' buttons; let the card itself be the link
findings.why: Equal card grids are the default skeleton; the orphan card shows the layout was not composed for the content count.

findings.where: goal and tool cards, hero badge
findings.evidence: Every card carries a tracked caps label above its heading that repeats the heading: 'VIDEO' over 'Start a YouTube channel', 'DESIGN' over 'Design faster', 'WRITING' over 'Grow a blog'; plus the pill eyebrow 'Personalized AI tool bundles' above the h1.
findings.before: LEARNING / Study smarter; VIDEO / Start a YouTube channel
findings.after: Delete the caps labels on goal cards (the heading already says it); keep category only on tool cards if it is a filter
findings.why: Eyebrow-over-heading on every card is a template reflex; deleting them loses nothing (T-DELETION).

findings.evidence: Floating mock cards 'Your goal / Start a YouTube channel', 'Recommended stack', 'Workflow 1-2-3' over a pale gradient slab: a static dashboard-style mock with illustrative data, the standard 'product UI floating in the hero' device.
findings.before: Three floating faux-UI cards on a tinted slab
findings.after: Show the real first question of the flow inline so the hero is the product, or one real recommendation output with a link
findings.why: Mock-UI hero is a look-family tell the sweep cannot measure.

findings.evidence: '17 curated tools · 5 budget tiers · 3 questions' stat trio under the CTAs; the stat band is filler proof (counts of the product's own config, not outcomes).
findings.after: Drop the row, or replace with one concrete example output
findings.why: Stat trio is a stock hero accessory; T-THREE-LINE: not picturable as value to the visitor.

findings.evidence: T-FRESH-READER lines that fit any site: 'Search the full library of curated tools.', 'Side-by-side on price, level, and best use.', 'Win clients, deliver faster, and look bigger than you are.' Em-dash pair in the sub-line 'Answer three questions — your goal, budget, and technical level — and get a tailored bundle'.
findings.before: "Search the full library of curated tools."
findings.after: Say what is in it: '17 tools, priced in USD or INR, filtered by what you want to make'
findings.why: Generic subheads make the page interchangeable.

findings.evidence: Footer is the logo plus the h1 repeated ('Tell us the goal. We'll build the stack.'); 'A' letter-in-blue-square logo is a placeholder mark.
findings.before: Blue rounded square with 'A' + repeated tagline
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: real logo mark]; footer with contact, about, data sources/affiliate disclosure
findings.why: Placeholder logo and echoed tagline read as scaffold left in place.

strengths: The concept is concrete: a goal -> budget -> level flow returning named tools (Perplexity, ElevenLabs, CapCut) with real prices and a USD/INR toggle for an Indian audience.
The comparison table is plain and useful ('Best for: Faceless video and podcast narration').
not_investigated: no 00-contract.md brief in the run directory; judged without brand overrides
site scripts were blocked in capture (manifest network.blocked), so the interactive flow behind 'Find my stack' was not seen
